unsupported: Factory firmware boot and full application behavior remain unverified; no physical hardware validation.

No STM32 CPU execution, chained slave boards, 14-LED mode/PWM registers, alternate ST7735/ST7789 images or newer LovyanGFX offset conventions. Unknown LED registers are deliberately rejected by this partial device model.
Only the host has four visible panels; chip-select bit0 for the fifth/slave position has no attached panel. The physical rotary push shares ESP32 BOOT0 and STM32 KEY5.

Visible RGB565 window commands only; controller readback, analog gamma/supply timing and RAM outside documented glass are not modeled. STM32 source has a malformed case label in an unrelated LED branch; source inspection is not proof that the current full firmware builds or boots.
STM32G030 has 64KB Flash and 8KB SRAM; the product listing terminology PSRAM does not make this memory ESP32 PSRAM.
runtimeSupport.firmwareCompatibility: No factory image is claimed working by a board protocol test.

conflicts.resolution: The pinned legacy header now defaults to ST7735 with different offsets. This profile explicitly selects GC9107 offsets, IPS inversion and MADCTL0=C8. The newer Library uses different LovyanGFX dimensions/offsets and is not silently treated as compatible.
Original hardware date 2024-09-05 in manufacturer README replaces 2024-09-28 storefront publication proxy; neither independently establishes retail availability.

firmwareCompatibility.behavior: The original STM32 address callback interprets the previous receive buffer at the next write-address phase. CS selection and key/version snapshots therefore become effective on the next write. This is not a generic promise for other STM32 images or revisions.
